This is a placeholder for CoverityTool.exe
------------------------------------------
On Linux sandbox we cannot build a Windows .exe directly.
To get the real exe:
  1. On Windows 10/11 with Python 3.10+ installed
  2. Unzip this setup folder
  3. Double-click build_exe.bat (in repo root, not in dist)
  4. After 2-4 minutes, dist/CoverityTool/CoverityTool.exe will appear
  5. That exe + its _internal folder is what you ship

For now, testers can run via Python:
  python -m venv .venv
  .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
  pip install -r requirements.txt
  python local_gui.py

See docs/Coverity_Tool_User_Guide.docx Appendix C for full build steps.
